notes.title: Smoots Crazy Wave splashes on Steam today!
notes.content: [p]🎉 The craziest jet-ski races are now available on [b]Steam[/b] & [b]Steam Deck[/b]![/p][p][/p][p]Dive into [i]Smoots Crazy Wave[/i] 🌊, the latest game in the Smoots series! Enjoy fun racing for up to [b]4 players in split-screen mode[/b].[/p][p][/p][p]Different modes await you: 🏆 [b]Championship[/b]: Become the ultimate jet-ski master! ↩️ [b]Slalom[/b]: Show off your precision and speed! 💥 [b]Battle Royale[/b]: Only one can survive!  ⏱  [b]Time Trial[/b]: Beat the clock and set records! 👓 [b]Practice[/b]: Learn all the circuits and perfect your skills![/p][p][/p][h3]🎮 Play now on [b]Steam[/b] and [b]Steam Deck[/b] — fully compatible! ✅[/h3][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3844020?utm_source=jandu&utm_campaign=release&utm_medium=steamevent"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Smoots Summer Games 2 is now available on Steam!
notes.content:
🎉 Smoots Fans, today is a great day!

🏃‍♂️ Smoots Summer Games 2, the latest entry in the Smoots series, is now available on Steam!

🏹 Classic sports and exciting new events like cycling and archery await you! Play solo or enjoy with friends and family in local multiplayer mode.

[h3]🎮 Now available on Steam and fully playable on Steam Deck! ✅
[/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3094450?utm_source=summerevent

notes.title: Steam Next Fest - Special Stream Event
notes.content:
On Wednesday, June 16th, at 10 AM Pacific, right at the start of the Steam Next Fest, our community team jumps in to play Nine to Five, discuss the Next Fest, and answer your questions!

Tune in if you want to beat us at our own game, have a laugh, or if you want to see what the game looks like before playing it yourself!

With thousands of titles around the globe, Steam presents the world's largest and most varied selection of games with an attractive live program. [i]The Steam Next Fest[/i]

And [b]Smoots Summer Games[/b] is one of the selected games.

In order to celebrate it, we are going to stream 24/7 and let the users play our game in a public demo.

And this is not the only surprise we've got in store for you.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40284534/049c4148eb4af744f93555f882eba8c517009117.png[/img]
